version: 001
Authorization: draft — 2026-10-27
who: Codex Prime
state: draft; awaiting Director release
Face: 05
PPPP: 0507
book: 00.00.10.work
keyword: prime-support

## Assignment
Executor: Claude Colab/design lead. Reviewer: Codex Prime.
Release: PENDING. Claim: PENDING.
The Director's release also confirms this proposed 0507 page allocation.
QUEUE THIS AFTER completing 0506.clerk-handoff/05.03. Do not abandon that return.
Design only: no implementation, worker invocation, queue edits or Git writes.
Frozen input commit: 54274e698dde1c6cbd5e25177395c62c2a2c645a; all 12 inputs are
bundled under evidence/pack05.01, with source-manifest.tsv.
Your 0506/05.03 seam design is not an input yet. When your own design
returns, reference its exact local artifact/hash as additional DESIGN evidence,
without claiming Prime acceptance. Do not read changing Builder source as baseline.

## Finish line
One entry can show all declared lanes with source identities and what needs Prime
attention; one new returned artifact can be identified, reviewed and acknowledged
without chat search or guessing a destination. Design a small first implementation
slice for STATUS and INTAKE. Outline assignment preparation/readiness checks only
as later dependencies. This module assists Prime, never replaces its judgment.

## #01 — Notes, existing contract and source ownership
Read 06.01 first. Write NEW 06.02 notes before the design. Trace current sources:
global assignment, page-local release/claim/return, Clerk store, app receipts,
Observer branch and separate project reference. For every displayed fact, say
which record owns it and whether it is read, derived, supplied or unknown.
Identify missing machine-readable fields explicitly. Recommend the minimum adapter
or record change; don't pretend free prose or a filename supplies execution state.
Propose where discovery lives without duplicating editable queue/job state or
allocating another desk. Cross-repository lanes must be explicit registrations,
never an unbounded filesystem crawl or a network scan of all user repositories.

## #02 — Status and one concrete operator view
Propose exact module/CLI boundaries and a sample status report: lane/project,
owner/role label, current work, declared state, dependencies/blockers, latest
returned artifact/revision, review status and one named next attention target.
Differentiate release eligibility, current execution, transport completion,
review and acceptance. A conflict/missing source/stale snapshot must remain visible.
Do not pick a highest-version face or guess a next command. Include local versus
published revision, local uncommitted work and last-observed remote revision.
Default status inspection is read-only and compact; it must not fetch all remotes,
run workers, update source views or mark reviewed. Show how context packets can
point to exact sources without feeding the model every historical artifact.

## #03 — Intake and durable review identity
Define when a return is NEW and when it is the same artifact already seen. Preserve
producer revision/content identity separately from a containing file later gaining
Prime notes. Don't requeue Prime's own appended review as another Builder return.
Explicitly handle amended returns, an incomplete return, missing evidence, duplicates
and a conflicting source. An intake acknowledgement is not review completion or
acceptance. Unanswered findings cannot disappear during regeneration or closure.
Use the existing page-local finding/response/elevation contract; count reviewed
passes accurately, not every file edit or every Observer poll.

Observer source: Amalgamour/Librarian, observer/reviews,
00.kernel/00.00.10.work/0505.observer-design/notes/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.md, Central time.
Notes are append-only advisory records. Prime replies on the relevant work page,
never changes Observer text or writes its branch. The existing pinned review is
0502/06.02 at e865d3c56faa17b8c9d38f2af2765b3d8f6d18be. No note is pinned in
this pack; use clearly labelled synthetic notes in examples, not invented findings.
Propose explicitly invoked intake/fetch into an independent cache, with allowlisted
repository/ref and last-seen revision. No scheduler/automation, hidden polling,
credentials or Git fetch in shared working checkouts. No receipt or note is authority.

## #04 — Examples, next slice and checks
Write evidence/design05.01/DESIGN.md plus minimal example records/report. Show
at least app lane, Clerk lane and a synthetic separate-project lane (SoF is real
but do not read or modify its working checkout). Walk one synthetic return through
unseen -> seen -> review-needed -> reviewed with an unresolved finding -> answered
or escalated; same input is idempotent, amended output creates a reviewable revision.
Show the status when a canonical assignment and page-local execution disagree.
Recommend ONE small first implementation batch with exact files, interfaces,
dependencies and fixture acceptance checks. Reuse the repaired Clerk concept;
if it isn't yet accepted, name that prerequisite rather than building a parallel
dispatcher. No UI, role registry, approval engine, worker scheduling or full four-
module framework. Prefer routine recommendations to Director questionnaires.

## #05 — Shadow-Prime handover experiment
Propose a bounded manual evaluation after these tools work: a fresh Prime reads
only the published entry/status/needed sources, reports the situation, proposes
assignments and handles one fixture return while Codex independently observes.
State what Codex checks, how disagreements and interventions are retained, and
what evidence supports expanding responsibility. Do not grant any new model
authority, launch it, claim a cold-boot test occurred or automate promotion.

## #06 — Reread and return
Reread the complete proposal against frozen sources and seed notes. Account for
notes, record hashes, and return HERE with Did, Blocked, Need; what exists vs is
proposed, the first implementation slice and only material Director decisions.
May edit this 05.01 and create 06.02 plus evidence/design05.01 under this page only.
No app/lab/kernel/other page/store, shared assignment/view/queue, Git, network or
model writes/calls; no tools built or executed. Preserve the current Builder lanes.

Then read and execute: D:\Git\lib-build\00.kernel\00.00.10.work\0507.prime-support\05.01.md I release this batch for design work and confirm the proposed 0507 work-page allocation. Design Prime status and intake first. Reuse the existing Clerk direction; do not create a competing queue or dispatcher. Include one bounded implementation recommendation and a manual fresh-Prime trial with Codex observing. Use the pinned sources. Preserve all builder lanes and SoF. - Builder assignment is Prime's.

Shadow-Prime trial (DESIGN §8). This is a proposal: nothing is launched and no authority is granted.
- When: after slice 1 is accepted.

- verified: the pack pins; 0410 keys; 0401 values; the 0505 status and resolution words and the two-pass rule; 0502/06.02 rows; 0506/05.01's Disposition; the three 0504/05.05 revisions' hashes; every synthetic prefix computed from the example files.

store, or a shadow Prime. No implementation or session trial ran in this review.

  Prime reproduced two different return bodies with the same identity when such
  a line appears inside a fenced example. Use one exact recognized top-level
  Review heading outside fenced blocks; reject ambiguous/misordered structures.
  Test fenced decoys, heading prefixes, duplicate headings and normal appended
  reviews. Do not let a later differing payload inherit an earlier review.
  Define which bytes are reviewable and how pre-boundary metadata edits behave;

  `returns/sof-gm-kit-pass01.md` on `sof/gm-kit`, not at a root 05.NN page.
  Register an exact return-file source kind alongside page folders, or clearly
  report it unsupported. Prefer the small explicit adapter. No repository crawl
  and no conversion of SoF's history into workshop page numbering.

  the current page no longer carries an older Review. Use declared review sources
  or bounded source history, never the acknowledgement store as a findings ledger.
  Missing historical evidence is unknown/attention, not zero findings. Add a test
  deleting acknowledgements and removing the old Review from the amended page.

Implementation guidance: reserve only provisional fixture schemas for the four
one-line fields. M02 is not adopted as universal law by this review. M01 may remain
an explicit temporary --intake path for the lab; defer a real store installation.
Status must describe scan scope, last-observed refs, unsupported sources and
legacy unknowns. A fixture acknowledgement may not edit real work pages or refs.
The attention priority is a configurable written recommendation, not authority.
The illustrative current-state report is dated to its input snapshot; it is not
today's live status after subsequent Prime reviews/publications.

Next bounded action: implement the fixture-only status/intake lab with PS-01–03
covered, then demonstrate it against a disposable snapshot containing both a
workshop return and the actual SoF bootstrap return format. No observer fetch,
Clerk adapter, app integration, model launch or real intake rollout yet.
Builder release remains a Director action. Claude can implement this bounded lab
after receiving a released assignment; this review is not itself that assignment.
